question: Who won the 'NSG Counter-IED and Counter-Terrorism Innovator Award 2021'?
solution:
The correct answer is__** **____**Shailesh Ganpule**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shailesh Ganpule** has **received **the **‘NSG Counter-IED & Counter-Terrorism Innovator Award 2021'** for his** design **of a** blast-resistant helmet**.
 
• He is a **professor **from** IIT Roorkee**.
 
• The **‘blast-resistant helmet’** designed by **Prof. Shailesh Ganpule** is an **advanced version **of **conventional helmets**.
 
• It protects **military personnel **from** IED-induced blast waves** with a** technology readiness of 4.​​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **​Shishir Sinha,** is a **professor **in the** Department of Chemical Engineering, Indian Institute **of **Technology Roorkee.**
